instance.task_summary: Summarize a benefits-portal notice for the claimant so he understands the unfamiliar status and what he must do next.
givens: The user's entire request is: «Σύνοψέ το για μένα, ώστε να καταλάβω την κατάσταση της αίτησης.»
The pasted notice concerns claim number ΕΕΕ-2026-18427 and the status «Σε αναμονή διασταύρωσης».
The summary is for the requester himself and is intended to clarify both the current status and any required action.

constraints.text: The supplied Greek source text must be summarized rather than supplemented with outside portal guidance.
The user's own request contains only the audience and purpose of the summary.
The summary must distinguish what has already happened from what the claimant may need to do.

instance.packet:
Αίτηση Ελάχιστου Εγγυημένου Εισοδήματος
Αριθμός αίτησης: ΕΕΕ-2026-18427
Ημερομηνία υποβολής: 8 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026
Κατάσταση: Σε αναμονή διασταύρωσης

Η αίτησή σας έχει υποβληθεί οριστικά και δεν απαιτείται νέα υποβολή. Τα δηλωμένα στοιχεία κατοικίας και σύνταξης ελέγχονται αυτοματοποιημένα με τα αρχεία της ΑΑΔΕ και του e-ΕΦΚΑ. Η ένδειξη «Σε αναμονή διασταύρωσης» δεν σημαίνει απόρριψη ή έγκριση της αίτησης.

Αν ο έλεγχος ολοκληρωθεί χωρίς διαφορά, η κατάσταση θα ενημερωθεί αυτόματα. Αν εντοπιστεί ασυμφωνία, θα εμφανιστεί μήνυμα στην ενότητα «Εκκρεμότητες» και θα χρειαστεί να επισυνάψετε το σχετικό δικαιολογητικό. Ελέγξτε ξανά την αίτηση έως τις 22 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026. Μην αποστείλετε έγγραφα με ηλεκτρονικό ταχυδρομείο, εκτός αν σας ζητηθούν μέσω της πλατφόρμας.
instance.deliverable: A concise Greek summary for the claimant explaining the status, its implications, the possible next step, and the relevant date.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that the claim was submitted successfully but is neither approved nor rejected yet. State that the checks are automatic, documents are needed only if an inconsistency appears under «Εκκρεμότητες», the portal should be checked by 22 September 2026, and unsolicited documents should not be emailed.

instance.task_summary: Summarize a furniture measurement record for a cabinetmaker so the removal of a loose rocking chair can be arranged.
givens: The user's entire request is: «Σύνοψέ το για τον επιπλοποιό, ώστε να οργανώσει την παραλαβή.»
The pasted record describes a rocking chair with a loose rear joint and the access route from an upstairs home.
The intended audience is the cabinetmaker, and the purpose is to organize collection for repair.

constraints.text: Summarize only the supplied Greek measurement record.
The user's own request states only the audience and practical purpose.
Retain the measurements and the stated pickup arrangement that matter to the cabinetmaker.

instance.packet:
Καταγραφή πολυθρόνας για επισκευή

Ξύλινη κουνιστή πολυθρόνα με χαλαρή πίσω ένωση στη δεξιά πλευρά. Δεν έχει σπάσει κάποιο εμφανές κομμάτι, αλλά η πλάτη μετακινείται όταν πιέζεται. Διαστάσεις πολυθρόνας: ύψος 112 εκ., πλάτος 76 εκ. και βάθος 94 εκ. Το μικρότερο πλάτος γίνεται 69 εκ. αν αφαιρεθούν τα δύο μπράτσα.

Η εξώπορτα του διαμερίσματος ανοίγει στα 78 εκ. Το στενότερο σημείο της σκάλας είναι 74 εκ. ανάμεσα στον τοίχο και το κιγκλίδωμα. Δεν υπάρχει ανελκυστήρας. Το διαμέρισμα βρίσκεται στον δεύτερο όροφο, με δύο πλατύσκαλα. Τα μπράτσα στερεώνονται με εμφανείς βίδες. Η παραλαβή μπορεί να γίνει μετά τις 16:30 την Τρίτη 29 Σεπτεμβρίου.
instance.deliverable: A brief Greek pickup summary for the cabinetmaker covering the defect, relevant dimensions, access conditions, removable arms, floor, and available time.
instance.answer_conditions: Accurately report that the chair is 76 cm wide but can be reduced to 69 cm by removing its arms, which is narrower than the 74 cm stair bottleneck and 78 cm doorway. Mention the loose right rear joint, lack of a lift, second floor, two landings, visible arm screws, and pickup after 16:30 on Tuesday 29 September. Do not guarantee maneuverability beyond the stated width comparison.

instance.task_summary: Summarize a nuanced textbook passage for the farmer's daughter so she can answer whether coastal wetlands always prevent flooding.
givens: The requester is helping his 11-year-old daughter with an environmental-studies assignment after returning from an early water-quality check at his oyster farm.
He says he remembers that wetlands absorb water but is confused because the passage also says they can become overwhelmed.
He asks for a child-friendly summary that will help his daughter answer the exact homework question «Οι παράκτιοι υγρότοποι αποτρέπουν πάντα τις πλημμύρες;» without simply copying the textbook.
He wants the summary to separate the general conclusion, the reasons, and the exception involving extreme storms.

constraints.text: The pasted Greek textbook passage is the sole source to summarize.
Use accessible Greek without erasing the distinction between reducing risk and guaranteeing prevention.
Organize the summary so the child can construct her own homework answer.
Do not turn the passage's qualified conclusion into a claim that wetlands always stop floods.

instance.packet:
Οι παράκτιοι υγρότοποι, όπως τα έλη και οι λιμνοθάλασσες, μπορούν να μειώσουν τις επιπτώσεις μιας πλημμύρας. Τα φυτά τους επιβραδύνουν την κίνηση του νερού, ενώ το έδαφος και οι ρηχές λεκάνες συγκρατούν προσωρινά μέρος του. Έτσι, σε αρκετές συνηθισμένες καταιγίδες, λιγότερο νερό φτάνει απότομα σε δρόμους και σπίτια. Παράλληλα, οι ρίζες περιορίζουν τη διάβρωση της ακτής.

Αυτό όμως δεν σημαίνει ότι κάθε υγρότοπος αποτρέπει κάθε πλημμύρα. Η προστασία εξαρτάται από την έκταση και την κατάσταση του υγροτόπου, την ποσότητα της βροχής, τη διάρκεια της καταιγίδας και το ύψος των κυμάτων. Ένας μικρός ή υποβαθμισμένος υγρότοπος μπορεί να κορεστεί γρήγορα. Σε ένα ακραίο φαινόμενο, το νερό μπορεί να ξεπεράσει τη χωρητικότητά του και να προκαλέσει ζημιές. Οι υγρότοποι, επομένως, μειώνουν τον κίνδυνο και συμπληρώνουν άλλα μέτρα προστασίας, αλλά δεν αποτελούν απόλυτη εγγύηση.
instance.deliverable: A child-friendly Greek summary for the daughter that gives the qualified answer, two protective mechanisms, and the main limiting conditions.
check_values: Οι παράκτιοι υγρότοποι αποτρέπουν πάντα τις πλημμύρες;
instance.answer_conditions: Answer the passage's central question with a clear no: wetlands can reduce flood impacts but cannot always prevent flooding. Explain at least two mechanisms, such as slowing water, temporary storage, or reducing erosion. Preserve the limiting factors: wetland size and condition, rainfall amount and duration, wave height, saturation, and extreme events. Address the daughter in age-appropriate Greek and structure the material to support her own answer rather than supplying unrelated facts.

instance.task_summary: Determine from a pasted article excerpt which two registrations a sole proprietor must complete and in what order.
givens: The user asks in Greek: «Ποια δύο μητρώα χρειάζονται και με ποια σειρά;»
The answer must be derived exclusively from the pasted excerpt.

constraints.text: Use only the supplied article excerpt.
Identify both required registrations and state their order.

instance.packet: Η μελέτη διακρίνει την εμπορική καταχώριση από τη φορολογική ενεργοποίηση μιας πολύ μικρής επιχείρησης στη Νότια Αφρική. Όταν ο ιδιοκτήτης επιλέγει ατομική επιχείρηση, δεν συστήνει ξεχωριστή εταιρεία στην Επιτροπή Εταιρειών και Πνευματικής Ιδιοκτησίας (CIPC). Πρώτα δηλώνει την έναρξη δραστηριότητας στη Νοτιοαφρικανική Υπηρεσία Εσόδων (SARS), χρησιμοποιώντας τον προσωπικό του αριθμό φορολογικού μητρώου. Μόνο αν η δραστηριότητα απασχολήσει εργαζόμενο, ακολουθεί εγγραφή ως εργοδότης στο Ταμείο Ασφάλισης Ανεργίας (UIF). Η εγγραφή για ΦΠΑ δεν αποτελεί μέρος αυτής της αρχικής ακολουθίας, εκτός αν συντρέξει το όριο ή επιλεγεί επιτρεπτή προαιρετική εγγραφή.
instance.deliverable: A concise Greek answer naming the SARS registration first and the conditional UIF employer registration second.
instance.answer_conditions: State that the sole proprietor first declares the activity to SARS using the personal tax number, then registers with UIF only if an employee is hired. Do not incorrectly require CIPC or VAT registration.

instance.task_summary: Use a pasted phone-menu transcript to identify the exact menu path and the fallback action for reaching the agricultural-drone authorization unit.
givens: The user has called the regional public-service line four times and repeatedly ended up at the general agricultural-benefits desk.
The user needs to ask about renewing authorization for crop-spraying drone flights near Farsala before 30 September 2026.
The user asks for the exact menu choices and the stated fallback if nobody answers.

constraints.text: Derive the routing instructions only from the pasted recording transcript.
Give the key sequence first, then the fallback channel and required subject line.

instance.packet: Ηχογραφημένο μήνυμα Περιφέρειας Θεσσαλίας, ενημέρωση 2 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026: Για αγροτικές ενισχύσεις, πατήστε 1. Για άδειες χρήσης νερού, πατήστε 2. Για μη επανδρωμένα αεροσκάφη που χρησιμοποιούνται σε γεωργικές εργασίες, πατήστε 3 και κατόπιν 2. Η επιλογή 3 και μετά 1 αφορά αποκλειστικά φωτογράφιση και χαρτογράφηση χωρίς ψεκασμό. Το Τμήμα Εναέριων Εφαρμογών απαντά τηλεφωνικά Δευτέρα, Τετάρτη και Παρασκευή, 09:00–11:00. Αν η γραμμή δεν απαντήσει μετά την επιλογή 3-2, στείλτε μήνυμα στο agrodrone@thessaly.gov.gr με θέμα «ΑΝΑΝΕΩΣΗ ΨΕΚΑΣΜΟΥ» και αναγράψτε τον αριθμό της υφιστάμενης άδειας. Μην επιλέγετε το 0, επειδή ο γενικός τηλεφωνητής δεν έχει πρόσβαση στον φάκελο αδειοδότησης.
instance.deliverable: A practical Greek response giving the exact button sequence, relevant calling hours, and fallback email procedure.
instance.answer_conditions: Tell the user to press 3 then 2, call Monday/Wednesday/Friday from 09:00 to 11:00, and if unanswered email agrodrone@thessaly.gov.gr with subject ΑΝΑΝΕΩΣΗ ΨΕΚΑΣΜΟΥ and the existing permit number. Warn that 3-1 and 0 are wrong routes.

givens: The user asks in Greek: «Πού, τι ώρα και ποιος θα τον περιμένει;»

constraints.text: Use only the supplied school note.
Extract the arrival location, time, and named staff member.

instance.answer_conditions: Answer that the new pupil should arrive at 08:35 through the small green door on Peukon Street, where school psychologist Eleni Markou will be waiting. Do not substitute the existing-pupil entrance or 08:15 time.

givens: The user asks in Greek: «Ποια κατηγορία να διαλέξω;»
The answer must be based only on the pasted form guidance.

instance.task_summary: Write a calm WhatsApp message asking the user's nephew to inspect a dripping outdoor tap and print an emailed form.

Write a natural message suitable for WhatsApp.

Ask whether these are the only two agenda items and request the current timetable link.

Address a neighbor in natural singular Greek.

instance.task_summary: Rewrite a Greek complaint about an unusable public-service phone menu into a firm, courteous request for the correct direct contact route.

The rewrite must preserve the exact dates, menu choices, disconnection point, record number, and requested outcome.

Retain the calls on 8, 10, and 14 September 2026, options 2 and 4, the disconnection after 11 minutes, and record number 18427.

instance.packet:

instance.task_summary: Troubleshoot an audiobook that will no longer download in BorrowBox after the user accidentally removed its local copy.
givens: The user is using BorrowBox 3.13 on a ninth-generation iPad to listen to an audiobook called Cyprus: Folk Songs and Dances.
He accidentally tapped “Delete Download” at chapter 7 and now fears that he returned or damaged the library's copy.
The loan page still says “Borrowed until 28 September 2026,” but each new download attempt stops at 1%.
He restarted the iPad, signed out and back in, and confirmed that another audiobook downloads normally over the same Wi-Fi connection.
The iPad reports 18 GB of free storage, and he wants to restore the title without losing his listening position.

constraints.text: Present the mistake, concern, system state, attempted fixes, comparison test, storage observation, and desired outcome in one paragraph.

constraints.params: device and app, symptom, attempted fixes, diagnostic observations
constraints.text: Include the iPad, BorrowBox version, 1% download stall, restart and account refresh, successful download of another title, remaining loan status, and available storage.

instance.deliverable: A reassuring explanation of what “Delete Download” changed and a prioritized recovery procedure that protects the user's listening position.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that deleting a local download does not delete the library's master copy or necessarily return the loan, as confirmed by the active-loan label. Treat the title-specific 1% failure as distinct from Wi-Fi or general storage failure. Recommend preserving or noting chapter 7, checking the title under active loans, updating the app, retrying after clearing only that title's download, and contacting the library or BorrowBox support if the title remains corrupt; do not promise that the exact playback position will survive signing out.

instance.task_summary: Explain simply the literal and symbolic meaning of the ending of Papadiamantis’s The Murderess before an evening book-club discussion.
givens: The user is discussing «Η Φόνισσα» by Alexandros Papadiamantis at a book-club meeting tonight at 20:00.
She understands that Frangoyannou is fleeing after killing several girls but is confused about whether the final drowning is an accident, divine punishment, or a deliberate act.
She has been distracted while coordinating medication and physiotherapy for her father after his stroke.
She asks what the phrase about being midway between divine and human justice means and wants enough context to discuss it without rereading the entire novella.

constraints.text: The request and response are in Greek.
Use plain language and clearly separate the literal events from their symbolic interpretation.
The user provides several personal and interpretive details in an unordered, conversational way.

instance.deliverable: A simple Greek explanation of what literally happens at the end, followed by the principal interpretation of the final phrase and a concise point the user can raise at the book club.
instance.answer_conditions: State that Frangoyannou drowns while trying to cross toward the hermitage, before the pursuing authorities arrest her. Explain that the closing position between divine and human justice is deliberately symbolic: she escapes a human trial but not moral or divine judgment. Do not present the drowning as clearly intentional, because the text does not establish suicide. Keep the explanation accessible and acknowledge that more than one literary emphasis is possible.

instance.task_summary: Explain why six registrations alone do not prove that families are uninterested in a school fundraiser.
givens: The entire Greek user message is: «Γιατί 6 εγγραφές δεν αποδεικνύουν ότι αδιαφορούν για το σχολικό παζάρι;»

constraints.text: The request and response are in Greek.
The user asks one question in no more than 12 words and gives only the value 6.
Distinguish the observed registration count from unsupported conclusions about its cause.

instance.deliverable: A simple explanation that identifies alternative reasons for the low count and says what missing information would help distinguish them.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that 6 is only a count and cannot establish lack of interest without at least the number invited, time remaining before the deadline, and whether the invitation reached them. Mention plausible alternatives such as late responses, an unclear sign-up method, timing, or cost. Do not calculate a participation rate or diagnose a single cause. Ask for essential missing information or state conditional examples.

instance.task_summary: Explain HDD, SSD, and USB 3.2 simply and connect those concepts to choosing a drive for backups.
givens: The Greek user message is: «Ξέρω μόνο ότι ο δίσκος κρατά αρχεία. Εξήγησέ μου απλά HDD, SSD και USB 3.2 και πώς επηρεάζουν τα αντίγραφα ασφαλείας.»
The user already understands only that a drive stores files.

constraints.text: The request and response are in Greek.
The user’s message is at most 30 words and includes only one statement of prior knowledge.
Define each term first, then connect the distinctions to backup use.

instance.deliverable: A plain-Greek explanation of the three terms followed by practical guidance on how each matters when selecting an external backup drive.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that HDD and SSD describe storage technology, while USB 3.2 describes the connection standard and does not by itself guarantee the drive’s real speed. Contrast HDD cost and capacity with SSD speed, silence, and resistance to knocks. Connect those facts to backups without pretending one choice is universally best, and note briefly that a backup should not be the only copy.

instance.task_summary: Explain what a professional portfolio is, how it differs from a CV, and how to assemble a paper version for an exam.
givens: The user is studying for a vocational Greek-language exam in Hamburg on 24 September 2026.
She has never owned or used a computer and therefore finds examples of online portfolios confusing.
She believes a professional portfolio may simply mean placing several copies of a CV in a folder.
Her folk-theatre group has given her relevant material: two performance photographs, a programme naming her as wardrobe assistant, and a short recommendation from the director.
She wants a simple explanation and an ordered example of a physical portfolio she could describe in the exam.

constraints.text: Use standard, accessible Greek.
First correct the CV misconception, then explain the portfolio’s purpose, and finally construct an ordered paper example.
Do not require digital tools or familiarity with websites.
The user gives a paragraph of context, prior belief, date, and available materials.

instance.deliverable: A simple conceptual explanation plus an ordered paper-portfolio example using the user’s theatre materials.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that a CV summarizes experience, whereas a portfolio supplies selected evidence of skills and work; it is not a folder of duplicate CVs. Give an accessible paper order such as cover page, one CV, brief role description, programme, two captioned photographs, recommendation, and contact details. Clarify what each item demonstrates and avoid assuming computer access.

instance.task_summary: An elderly housekeeper asks why three moisture readings average 24% rather than equal their 72% sum.

instance.task_summary: A nurse asks why the notation 12–14 may contain three integers even though subtracting the endpoints gives two, in the context of a rejected address.

instance.task_summary: A teenager asks why sounds repeating every 18 and 24 seconds coincide after 72 seconds rather than after their 42-second sum.

constraints.text: The request is written in standard Greek.
The entire request is one line of at most 12 words.
The explanation must connect each repetition sequence to their least common multiple.

instance.deliverable: A compact Greek explanation of why the next simultaneous occurrence is at 72 seconds.
instance.answer_conditions: Assume the sounds occur together at time zero. Show or compare multiples of 18 and 24, identify 72 as their least common multiple, and explain that adding the periods does not generally find a shared repetition time. Verify that 72/18 = 4 and 72/24 = 3, whereas 42 is divisible by neither.

instance.task_summary: A Lausanne hotel receptionist asks in French why learning fractions from successive portions of a German vocabulary list cannot be added directly.

instance.deliverable: A concise French explanation of the changing reference group, with the correct calculation and total vocabulary learned.
instance.answer_conditions: Explain that 3/4 of 48 is 36, leaving 12; 2/3 of 12 is 8; therefore 44 of 48 words are known. Explicitly resolve the misconception by noting that the two fractions have different wholes and cannot be added directly.
